- text: "The burros tail succulent is holding on tightly! Here’s the trick:"
  - text: "☀️: it’ll do best in bright light to full sun. This one gets bright light outside 4-6 hours a day. During the fall and winter, it sits in my south facing window sill. You may have to add an additional grow light of your have it inside and it’s still drooping leaves with every little touch you give it."
  - text: "💧watering: during the fall and winter when it’s indoors, I know to water when the soil is completely dry and the leaves (beans) are able to be pinched just a bit. At that point, yes I fully saturate (drown that h*e)."
  - text: "🍂 soil: I use a cactus/succulent potting mix along with added gravel."
